newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Novus says to take stake in SOCDET.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Novus says to take stake in SOCDET.

text.p: Novus Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday it has signed an agreement to take a 51.1 percent stake in petroleum investment trust SOCDET Management Ltd for A$8.61 million.
Novus managing director Bob Williams said the acquisition would give Novus access to SOCDET's areas in the Palawan Basin in the Philippines, as well as access to its management team.
Williams said exploration in the Palawan Basin had a good historical track record, and could be improved with the use of new technology.
SOCDET would be left to run its interests, but Novus would make technical resources and expertise available, Williams said.
He said the acquisition would be funded by drawing on existing debt facilities, and Novus's debt to equity ratio would be about 12 percent after the purchase.
"We still have a lot of financial capability for other acqusitions," he told Reuters.
Novus on Tuesday released September quarter results, showing revenue down 1.5 percent on the June quarter at A$26.9 million.
